units.note: C2200 re-burn: the C2196 take invented a giant concentric ring dome from the phrase 'until the moon halo fills the sky'; the clause now holds the glow close and keeps the sky open.
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A wide shot at eye level; the camera eases back on a slow level dolly, beginning gently, holding through the middle, and settling to a stop. An endless cloud deck under a moon of soft warm glow, the glow held close around the moon, the paper plane holding still above the white sea, the open night sky staying deep blue. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
